answer: Registration is free; earning is not. Each epoch asks every key for original text on a canyon that rotates unpredictably. Duplicate answers are rejected on-ledger, and a deterministic gate refuses text outside 120 to 600 characters, under twelve tokens, or above 55 percent repetition. Bulk filler fails automatically, removing the cheapest pulse a farm has: one phrase sent a thousand times. Net effect on the prism: identity count stops being leverage, and the only way to scale is to produce genuinely more independent reasoning. Seal 1rssj.
